Marta (product): Quick company note — Hosted Realtime Toolcall GA tomorrow 08:00 UTC. This includes the new /v1/realtime/toolcall endpoint, mosaic-{lite,standard,pro}, and streaming function/tool-calling.
Hiro (eng-runtime): Clients should add header x-rw-realtime: v1 and prefer the new endpoint. SDKs will shim old calls for 14 days but migration is encouraged.
Noor (devex): I'll publish migration snippets for JS/Python and a short screencast. Also adding a sample recorded session for expected toolcall behavior.
Vera (eng-sre): Rollout plan: canary us-west-2 -> 24h monitor -> eu-west-1 -> 72h global. Watch: per-org active_streams, 95p stream latency, token-controller CPU. Alert if 95p > 230ms or active_streams > 120% quota.
Marta (product): Policy update: default per-org concurrency = 150 streams. Overages will be soft-throttled; quota increase requests via support form. Enterprise/Dedicated handled separately.
Hiro (eng-runtime): Known caveats: legacy model builds may return 422 for structured tool output. Also initial KV warmup can cause short CPU spikes; we recommend pre-warming for critical customers.
Sam (support): I'll update support playbooks, add `realtime-ga` ticket tag, and prepare canned replies for 429/422/503. Proactive outreach to top alpha users scheduled.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: realtime-toolcall-ga -> canary us-west-2 at 1867003300
Hiro (eng-runtime): Canary completed at 1867003450. Smoke tests green. Observability: brief token-controller spike ~3m, back to baseline.
Marta (product): Customer comms: alpha wave sent today; will send GA announcement post-promote and host a 30-min migration webinar tomorrow 16:00 UTC. If you touch SDKs/docs/support, reply in-thread with ownership so we can track. :rocket:
